audit.whatIsWrong: Early phase claimed Tongue Lash 'stuns you on the second hit'.
audit.why: Tongue Lash stuns only when the target already carries three An Acquired Taste stacks; on a fresh target it damages and slows. The lane's real early constraint is Thick Skin banking your chip damage.
audit.corrected: Early text now says he needs three stacks for the stun, and that chipping him just fills a shield — burst in one window instead.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 and first-item spikes told you to go 'while his Devour is on cooldown so he can't self-W burrow away'.
audit.why: Devour is his R, not his W, and it does not move him; the escape is Abyssal Dive (W) at 21/20/19/18/17s. The spike was keyed to the wrong cooldown entirely.
audit.corrected: Both spikes now key the all-in to Abyssal Dive being down at 21s rank 1.

audit.whatIsWrong: Devour was labelled (W) throughout, 'Abyssal Voyage (R)' was cited as his roaming ultimate, and the defining shroud interaction was missing.
audit.why: Riot's kit lists W Abyssal Dive, E Thick Skin, R Devour; there is no Abyssal Voyage. Twilight Shroud makes Akali unable to be selected by enemy spells, and Devour is a point-and-click cast — it will not fire on you inside the smoke. Thick Skin converts damage already stored, so poking him feeds the shield.
audit.corrected: All slots relabelled, Abyssal Voyage removed, and the shroud-blocks-Devour interaction stated on both the spike and the wants lines. Mirrors the opponent's audit at audits/top/tahmkench__akali.json.

edits.before: Tahm's Q tongue lash stuns you on the second hit, and his Thick Skin grey health soaks your Q poke and heals it back, so farm at Five Point Strike range and never walk into Q stun without Shroud up.
edits.after: Tahm's Tongue Lash only stuns once you carry three An Acquired Taste stacks, and Thick Skin banks your chip and converts it to a shield, so farm at Five Point Strike range and burst in one window.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) is your gap-close-plus-execute: wait for his Devour (W) to be down so he can't self-W burrow away, then E in and chain R cast-two off his missing health before Thick Skin regen kicks in.
edits.after: Perfect Execution (R) is your gap-close-plus-execute: go when Abyssal Dive (W) is down, 21s at rank 1, so he cannot dive out — then E in and chain R cast two off his missing health before Thick Skin converts.

edits.before: Rocketbelt or Lich Bane plus a Shroud (W) reset is your peak all-in window — your empowered-auto and Q burst can outpace his grey-health heal if you commit while his Devour is on cooldown.
edits.after: Rocketbelt or Lich Bane plus a Shroud reset is your peak all-in — inside the smoke you cannot be selected, so Devour will not cast on you at all. Commit while Abyssal Dive is down.

edits.before: His Devour eats your full combo and his Thick Skin grey health out-sustains your single-target burst — he tanks one rotation, devours to negate the kill, and burrows away, so you must close before he completes a tank build.
edits.after: Devour eats you mid-combo and Thick Skin converts everything you chipped into a shield — he tanks one rotation, eats you to deny the kill, and dives out with W, so close the lane before he finishes a tank build.

edits.before: Bait his Q tongue lash, then E-in and R-execute in the window where his Devour (W) is down before Thick Skin grey health refills
edits.after: Bait his Tongue Lash, then E-in and R-execute in the window where Abyssal Dive is down and his Thick Skin bank is empty

edits.before: Hit your Level 6 and first-item spike to all-in while his Devour is on cooldown and he can't burrow away
edits.after: Hit your Level 6 and first-item spike to all-in while Abyssal Dive is down and he can't dive out

edits.before: Use Shroud (W) to dodge his Q stun and reset the trade, then re-engage with an empowered Assassin's Mark auto
edits.after: Sit in Shroud to break his aim — unselectable, you cannot be Devoured at all — then re-engage with an empowered auto

edits.before: Land the Q tongue lash stun to lock your dash-in and punish you while your energy is dumped
edits.after: Build three An Acquired Taste stacks, then Tongue Lash for the stun while your energy is dumped

edits.before: Soak burst with Thick Skin grey health and Devour (W) you mid-combo to negate your one-shot and survive
edits.after: Bank your chip damage with Thick Skin and Devour you mid-combo to negate the one-shot and survive

edits.before: Drag the game long so his Devour, percent-HP damage and Abyssal Voyage (R) roams out-value your single-target burst
edits.after: Drag the game long so Devour, his percent-health damage and Abyssal Dive escapes out-value your single-target burst

edits.before: Tahm's early game is the Q tongue lash and Thick Skin grey health: the Q's second hit stuns you, and the grey health soaks your Five Point Strike poke and heals it right back, so chipping him at range barely sticks. Don't step up to throw a Q he can answer with a tongue grab — a single stun on you with no Shroud yet means you eat his full follow-up while your energy is dumped. Last-hit at Q range, hold E, and never E-commit into his stun before 6.
edits.after: Tahm's early game is Tongue Lash and Thick Skin: the lash slows and applies An Acquired Taste, and it only stuns once three stacks are on you, while Thick Skin banks the damage you chip in and converts it back into a shield. Poking him at range barely sticks — save it for one window. Don't step up to throw a Q he can answer with a lash; a stun with no Shroud yet means you eat the full follow-up while your energy is dumped. Last-hit at Q range and never E-commit before 6.

edits.before: Once you have all three basics plus Shroud, you can finally reset around his Q — bait the tongue lash, W into the smoke to drop his targeting, then re-engage with an empowered Assassin's Mark auto. At 6 your R is the difference: wait until his Devour (W) is on cooldown so he can't self-W burrow to safety, E in, and chain Perfect Execution so the cast-two execute lands before Thick Skin grey health can refill. This and your first item are your only clean kill windows.
edits.after: Once you have all three basics plus Shroud, you can finally reset around his lash — bait it, W into the smoke where he cannot select you at all, then re-engage with an empowered Assassin's Mark auto. At 6 your R is the difference: wait until Abyssal Dive (W) is on cooldown, 21s at rank 1, so he cannot dive away, E in, and chain Perfect Execution so the cast-two execute lands before Thick Skin converts his banked grey health. This and your first item are your only clean kill windows.

edits.before: Late, his drain-tank math turns against you: Thick Skin grey health plus Devour let him tank a full combo, eat your burst mid-rotation, and burrow off to regen — your single-target one-shot pattern can't punch through that durability. He also leaves lane with Abyssal Voyage (R) to make plays elsewhere. Convert your Level 6-to-first-item lead into a tower and a kill now, because if this goes long he out-sustains you and becomes a peel-bot for his carries.
edits.after: Late, his drain-tank math turns against you: a full Thick Skin bank plus Devour let him tank a whole combo, eat you mid-rotation, and dive off with Abyssal Dive to reset — your single-target one-shot pattern can't punch through that durability, and anti-heal has to be up before you even start. Convert your Level 6-to-first-item lead into a tower and a kill now, because if this goes long he out-sustains you and becomes a peel-bot for his carries.

edits.before: Tahm's Thick Skin grey health soaks your Five Point Strike poke and his Q tongue lash stuns any step-up while you have no Shroud or sustain yet.
edits.after: Tahm's Thick Skin banks your Five Point Strike poke straight back as a shield, and Tongue Lash slows any step-up while you have no Shroud yet.

edits.before: Perfect Execution (R) gives you a gap-close-plus-execute — on his Devour cooldown you E-in and land R cast-two before grey health refills and before he can burrow.
edits.after: Perfect Execution gives you a gap-close-plus-execute — go when Abyssal Dive is down, 21s at rank 1, and land R cast two before Thick Skin converts.

edits.before: Rocketbelt/Lich Bane plus a Shroud reset is your hardest all-in, fast enough to outrun his Thick Skin heal if you commit while Devour is down.
edits.after: Rocketbelt/Lich Bane plus a Shroud reset is your hardest all-in — and inside the smoke Devour cannot even be cast on you, so commit there.

edits.before: His Devour and stacked Thick Skin grey health out-last your single-target burst — he tanks the combo, devours to negate the kill, and roams with Abyssal Voyage while you scale worse.
edits.after: Devour and a stacked Thick Skin shield out-last your single-target burst — he tanks the combo, eats you to deny the kill, and dives out with Abyssal Dive while you scale worse.

edits.before: Shroud his tongue — Q-poke, deny his dive. Akali wins the Tongue Lash cooldown windows.
edits.after: Shroud denies Devour outright — burst in one window. Akali wins the Abyssal Dive gaps.

edits.before: Shroud rewrites any trade he starts. Only take the trade when Tahm Kench's Tongue Lash is down.
edits.after: Shroud makes you unselectable, so Devour cannot cast on you. Trade when Tongue Lash is down.

edits.before: - Tahm Kench Tongue Lash: matchup-defining — His stun. Shroud-dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Tahm Kench Tongue Lash: matchup-defining — it stuns only at three An Acquired Taste stacks. - Abyssal Dive, 21s: his escape, so all-in when it is down. - Devour cannot be cast on you inside Shroud.

edits.before: His stun. Shroud-dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: His stun needs three stacks. Engage once Abyssal Dive is down.

edits.before: Fight into his W reactivate
edits.after: Fight into his Thick Skin

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Chip damage banks into his shield — burst in one window instead.

notes: 'Abyssal Voyage (R)' does not exist in the current kit — his ultimate is Devour and his W is Abyssal Dive; the content layer had Devour on W and used the phantom name for the roam. CHART CONFLICT: content win[6] says 'Akali' at two-plus items, but spikes[3], late and whys[6] all say Tahm Kench takes the late game, and the mirror audit (audits/top/tahmkench__akali.json) also gives him two-plus items. I did not edit the chart entry because a one-word side flip cannot satisfy the length band; it needs the applier or mirror-fix to set win[6] and full phases[6].side to Tahm Kench.
